input: Draft a reading curriculum for my homeschool co-op

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Reading Curriculum for Homeschool Co-op
gold.taskDescription: Create a structured reading curriculum tailored to the user's homeschool co-op group.

questions.title: What age or grade range are the students?
questions.description: Identify the age or grade levels of the children in the co-op to ensure the curriculum is developmentally appropriate.

questions.title: How many students are in the co-op?
questions.description: Understand the group size to determine how the curriculum should be structured for instruction and activities.

questions.title: What is the current reading level of the students?
questions.description: Gauge whether students are beginning readers, developing readers, or advanced, to set the right starting point.

questions.title: How many weeks or months should the curriculum span?
questions.description: Determine the intended duration of the curriculum to pace lessons and reading selections appropriately.

questions.title: How often does the co-op meet each week?
questions.description: Understand the meeting frequency to structure lessons, assignments, and reading goals around available class time.

questions.title: Are there specific genres, themes, or book titles required?
questions.description: Find out if there are any mandated or preferred reading materials, themes, or genres to include in the curriculum.

questions.title: What skills should the curriculum prioritize building?
questions.description: Clarify whether the focus is on phonics, fluency, comprehension, literary analysis, vocabulary, or a combination of these skills.
